work.title: Wall and Pavement, Snowmen
work.description: Two-register street photograph: above, a cubist red, white and blue paste-up reading 'CARRIER' and 'EAR' with stylised faces in linocut style; below, a cream pavement covered in black graffiti tags hosts three small white Mr. Snowmann figures in spread formation.
work.composition: two-register: paste-up wall above, tagged pavement below
